description: This file defines multiple data pipeline classes for processing dataframes within the PyTorch data utilities, including concatenation, shuffling, filtering, and aggregation of dataframes, with specific focus on dataframes as data pipes.

classes.name: DataFramesAsTuplesPipe
classes.description: Data pipe that yields dataframes as tuples using df_wrapper.iterate.

classes.name: PerRowDataFramesPipe
classes.description: Data pipe that yields each row of a dataframe individually, replacing pandas API with TorchArrow API.

classes.name: ConcatDataFramesPipe
classes.description: Data pipe that concatenates a batch of dataframes into a single dataframe.

classes.name: ShuffleDataFramesPipe
classes.description: Data pipe that shuffles all dataframes in the source data pipe.

classes.name: FilterDataFramesPipe
classes.description: Data pipe that filters dataframes based on a provided filter function.

classes.name: ExampleAggregateAsDataFrames
classes.description: Data pipe that aggregates items into dataframes of a specified size.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the data pipe with source data pipe and optional parameters.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Generator method that yields processed dataframes according to the specific data pipe logic.

methods.name: _as_list
methods.description: Converts an item to a list, handling exceptions.
